owner's rule.place in line: the first family on the waitlist is number 1

release package.test results: shown on the run's Summary page

team.how a release happens today: Pull requests run the tests automatically. On Thursday a developer builds the release by hand (about 15 minutes) and posts screenshots for the owner. The owner signs off on Friday morning. A developer then copies the release to the live server over the lunch hour (about 30 minutes) and checks the main pages by hand. Undoing a release takes about an hour.
team.tests today: run automatically on every pull request
team.who checks a release: the owner signs off on Fridays
